details.completeness_justification: All HIGH-importance criteria (K1-K5) are fully represented with core material meaning covered in the candidate summary. MEDIUM criteria K6 is also present. K7 (geographical sales shift) and K8 (defense market project) are missing entirely, but these are of lower importance and do not change the overall understanding of the company's performance, strategy, and financial position. The summary captures the main picture of financial improvement, operational challenges, strategic diversification, product innovation, and liquidity management.
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary demonstrates strong internal logical coherence. All statements build upon each other without contradiction: sales growth (S2) leads to operational improvements (S3-S5), which are partially offset by currency impacts (S6-S7). The narrative flows from revenue performance through cost management to profitability outcomes, with clear cause-effect relationships (e.g., structural adjustments in S4 directly causing deficit reduction in S5). Market context (S9) and strategic wins (S10-S11) provide complementary context without conflicting with financial results. Balance sheet management (S12) and year-end positioning (S13) form a logical conclusion. No material repetitions or organizational breaks are present, and all relationships (e.g., currency impact on margin) are internally consistent.
